title: KnitTrans: Coordinated Trajectory Transfer for Effective and Efficient LLM Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32389v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Trajectory transfer from rollout to training affects both learning quality and system efficiency in large language model reinforcement learning (RL). Enforcing batch-wide training requirements can delay the admission of completed trajectories, resulting in higher architectural staleness: the additional parameter-version gap from disaggregated pipelining relative to colocated execution. Beyond admission, misalignment between data access and training consumption causes redundant movement and unnecessary waiting when transferring large trajectory payloads. We present KnitTrans, a system that coordinates the rollout-to-training path through three designs. First, constraint-preserving mini-batch admission allows flexibility in early mini-batch composition, while checking that enough capacity remains to satisfy the remaining quotas. translated_title: KnitTrans：面向高效且有效的大语言模型强化学习的协同式轨迹传输
translated_abstract: 在大型语言模型强化学习（RL）中，从采样到训练的轨迹传输会同时影响学习质量和系统效率。强制执行跨整个批次的训练要求可能会延迟已完成轨迹的准入，从而导致更高的架构陈旧性，即相对于同置执行而言，解耦流水线所带来的额外参数版本差距。除准入问题外，数据访问与训练消费之间的错位在传输大规模轨迹负载时会造成冗余的数据移动和不必要的等待。我们提出了 KnitTrans，一个通过三项设计来协调从采样到训练路径的系统。第一，保持约束的迷你批次准入机制在早期迷你批次组成上提供了灵活性，同时检查剩余容量是否足以满足剩余配额。第二，按需轨迹数据访问将存储单元与消费方分配相匹配，并使微型批次（计算）重叠（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: KnitTrans 通过保持约束的迷你批次准入和按需轨迹数据访问等协同设计，优化大语言模型强化学习中从采样到训练的轨迹传输，在降低架构陈旧性的同时提升学习质量与系统效率。
en_tdlr: KnitTrans coordinates rollout-to-training trajectory transfer in LLM reinforcement learning through designs such as constraint-preserving mini-batch admission and on-demand trajectory data access, reducing architectural staleness while improving both learning quality and system efficiency.
